programs.desc: Jack tags along on Amy and Ty's romantic trip to Pike River.

programs.title: A Vineyard Romance
programs.desc: When Seattle magazine writer Samantha Hart is sent home to write an article about the wedding destination of Hawthorne Vineyards, she discovers the ex who broke her heart not only runs the vineyard, but he's about to get married there.

programs.title: The Royal Bake Off
programs.desc: Allie führt ein Café gegenüber ihrer ehrgeizigen Cousine Marily, und beide wetteifern um das beste Café. Als Prinz Henry in die Stadt kommt, fordert er sie zu einem Wettbewerb um das legendäre Familienrezept ihrer Großmutter, um den perfekten Krönungskuchen für die Hochzeit seines Bruders zu backen. Während Allie fair bleibt, ist Marily bereit, zu schummeln, um zu gewinnen.

programs.title: Stepping Into Love
programs.desc: When her art museum faces money problems, a traditional curator works with an unconventional artist to develop a daring exhibit. She must learn to color outside the lines to save the museum and find love.

programs.title: Mr. Pawsitively Perfect
programs.desc: An aspiring marketing designer's favorite foster dog is adopted by a famous, but down-on-his-luck furniture designer, whom she fears only wants the dog for his new image.

programs.title: Loving Every Minute
programs.desc: When Stephanie inherits a watch, she learns that it allows her to travel back in time five minutes one time each day. As she uses it more and more, her life and romance with her co-worker Hunter don't shake out the way she had hoped.
